exposure.needed: whether dashboards, alerting rules, or other metric consumers reference the metric name lbipam_ips_used_total

consequence.statement: The same LB IPAM usage metric is exposed under the new name lbipam_ips_used, so any reference to the old name lbipam_ips_used_total must be updated to lbipam_ips_used.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerting rules, and any other metric references from lbipam_ips_used_total to lbipam_ips_used.

assertion.statement: The Prometheus metric `lbipam_ips_used_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_ips_used` in Cilium 1.17.0, so metric references using the old name must be updated to the new name.
